# The Yard

> The Yard is a Singapore gymnastics club founded in 2016 by Rosanna Trigg and operated by People In Motion Pte. Ltd. (UEN 201535741C). It runs four centres: Jurong, Bukit Timah, Dempsey and Dover. Recreational gymnastics (Gym Tots, KinderTots, FUNdamentals) runs at all four centres from 18 months of age. A selection-based competitive WAG and MAG pathway trains at the Jurong arena. Trial classes are bookable online at every centre with the fee shown at booking; competitive entry starts with a free assessment arranged with the centre team.

Key facts:
- Recreational programmes: Gym Tots (18 months to 3), KinderTots (3 to 4) and FUNdamentals (5 to 10) at all four centres; Warriors (advanced recreational) at Bukit Timah and Dover; Senior Warriors (10 to 16) at Dover; Boys Tots and Boys FUNdamentals at Dempsey and Dover; Heroes, Legends and Gladiator are progression levels reached through a coach.
- Competitive WAG and MAG: by assessment and invitation only, and the assessment is free. Squads follow SGLP and USAG Levels 1 to 10, train 6 to 24 hours a week on an August to July season at all four centres. The Jurong arena (17,500 square feet, Olympic grade, opened November 2025) hosts the club's meets. Yard-hosted meets: the Lion City Classic (April) and the Diamond Classic (March) at Jurong, plus the annual Christmas Show in December.
- Other programmes at selected centres: Ninja Zone at Bukit Timah and Dempsey only; Tumbling and Trampoline (10 to 16) at Jurong only; Freestyle at Dover (camps confirmed, weekly classes on enquiry); Adult (16 and over) Open Session at Jurong and Adult Foundation Gymnastics at Bukit Timah.
- Camps: five-day holiday camps (Monday to Friday, three hours a day) in every Singapore school holiday (March, June, September, December). Gymnastics camps at all four centres; Ninja camps at Bukit Timah and Dempsey; High Performance camps at Jurong; Freestyle camp at Dover.
- Birthday parties at all four centres: a 90-minute coached session plus 30 minutes in a decorated party room; Mini, Mega and Mighty packages for up to 24 guests; nut-free venue; self-catered.
- Centres: Jurong, 1 Venture Avenue, #03-03A, Perennial Business City, S608521, +65 6816 8022. Bukit Timah, 9 King Albert Park, #B1-01, KAP Mall, S598332, +65 6914 9669. Dempsey, 72 Loewen Road, Dempsey Hill, S248828, +65 6914 9660. Dover, 1010 Dover Road, #01-01, SPGG, S139658, +65 6914 9662. WhatsApp main line +65 8089 1440.
- Skills system: a 20-skill Skills Matrix per recreational level (18 of 20 to advance); skills medalled Bronze, Silver and Gold; assessments three times a year (Terms 1, 3 and 5).
- Every centre is nut-free, uses FIG-certified apparatus (Gymnova and Gao Fei), has a parent viewing area (no filming), and follows the Safe Sport Singapore safeguarding framework. Coach ratio is one to eight in most classes and one to six in KinderTots.
- Four pillars, each with its own line: Move (learning through motion, building your strength), Play (fueled with fun, designed for progress), Grow (developing character, skills for life) and Belong (individual journeys, unique pathways, one community). Families who train at The Yard are members of the club.
- Centre personalities: Dover is the All-Rounder, Dempsey the Scenic Studio, Bukit Timah the Ninja Hub and Jurong the High-Performance Arena.
- The Yard's coaches have taught gymnastics in Singapore for three decades; the four centres add up to more than 30,000 square feet of gym floor, with the Jurong arena at 17,500 square feet.
- Coaching philosophy: progress is the promise and the pace belongs to the child; foundations before sophistication; a coach calls every level move.
